title: 04_eventfree_valve_fidelity
interpretation: Event-free proto_valve vs the full event-driven sepsis_sbml model, both run through the same roadrunner/CVODE engine and the same Composite harness (severity 3, 2 h). Removing E_beat and the piecewise pulOpen valve leaves the filtered hemodynamics and the immune core almost unchanged: MAP tracks within 0.56 mmHg, HR within 0.098 /min, and blood pathogen / tissue integrity agree to 1e-09 relative. Cardiac output and SVR differ most (~6% / ~6%) because the 5 s filters and the continuous beat phase replace the per-beat latched values — instantaneous points are not meant to line up (compare per-beat summaries). This is the fidelity cost of the event-free speedup, measured within one engine so it isolates the structural change from the engine-vs-engine divergence that is the rest of this study.
